## 6. List of Prohibitions

Prohibitions fall into three kinds.

### 1. Prohibitions on the world

These say what [never occurs](concepts.md#c01), or what is [not guaranteed](concepts.md#c02).

| Source | What is prohibited | Form |
|---|---|---|
| [Loop](concepts.md#c31) | A [loop](concepts.md#c31) necessarily persists | [Not Guaranteed](concepts.md#c02) |
| [Cognitive obscuration](concepts.md#c35) | One side is pushed up while the total of the others does not fall; learning has no cost | [Never Occurs](concepts.md#c01) |
| [Coupling](concepts.md#c36) | Exchange necessarily brings understanding; contact necessarily leads to conflict | [Not Guaranteed](concepts.md#c02) |
| [Coupling](concepts.md#c36) | The same [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) brings the same results | [Not Guaranteed](concepts.md#c02) |
| [Taiji](concepts.md#c39) | A [taiji](concepts.md#c39) necessarily ends; it necessarily ends with one side disappearing | [Not Guaranteed](concepts.md#c02) |
| [Renewal](concepts.md#c42) | The [history](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) in which a [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) lies stops changing; a tradition freezes, an institution stands still ([Law of Flux](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c24)) | [Never Occurs](concepts.md#c01) |
| [Renewal](concepts.md#c42) | A tradition continues as it was | [Not Guaranteed](concepts.md#c02) |
| [Renewal](concepts.md#c42) | [Restoring](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c27) a [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) ([Law of Non-Restoration](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c28)) | [Never Occurs](concepts.md#c01) |
| [Impression](concepts.md#c45) | Uniquely deriving the next [moment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09) of a [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) that is not [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12), including one's own ([Law of the Black Box](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c25)) | [Never Occurs](concepts.md#c01) |
| [Impression](concepts.md#c45) | A [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) knows itself completely ([Law of Attrition](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c26)) | [Never Occurs](concepts.md#c01) |
| [Impression](concepts.md#c45) | Completely understanding another [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) ([Incompleteness of Knowing Others](concepts.md#c19)) | [Not Guaranteed](concepts.md#c02) |

The prohibitions above hold for the past and for the future alike.

### 2. Prohibitions on statements

These say how the analyst may not infer or write. Their form is always "methodological prohibition".

| Source | Prohibited statement |
|---|---|
| Basic unit | Explaining an outcome by the essence of a person or group (an [individual](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c20) has no fixed core) |
| Basic unit | A conclusion changes with the [cut](concepts.md#c23), yet the [cut](concepts.md#c23) is not stated |
| [Renewal](concepts.md#c42) | Asserting that a nation or culture must become extinct (extinction is a label; it is a [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)) |
| [Impression](concepts.md#c45) | Writing a prediction about a [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) that is not [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12) as an outcome rather than as [weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) |
| [Impression](concepts.md#c45) | Taking what a [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) says as a complete description of what it is about |
| Explicit rules | From a purpose stated by a [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) alone, writing it as a complete explanation of the behavior |
| [Coupling](concepts.md#c36), [taiji](concepts.md#c39) | Speaking of [convergence](concepts.md#c37), [divergence](concepts.md#c38) or opposite directions without stating the dimension |
| Explicit rules | Treating "has not occurred" as "impossible" |
| Explicit rules | Treating the [impacts](concepts.md#c47) of [arrivals](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) as additive |
| Explicit rules | Writing an [empirical prohibition](concepts.md#c51) as a sufficient condition, or as a derived impossibility |

### 3. Empirical prohibitions

These are distilled from the examples; see "Conditions and reuse" in each example. They are revised with new cases, so they are not listed here.

## 7. Format of Examples

Examples are qualitative analyses and need no data. They are written in the following seven steps, each of which must produce something.

1. **[Boundary](concepts.md#c24)**: state the geographical [boundary](concepts.md#c24) and the temporal [boundary](concepts.md#c24).
2. **Initial state**: list the [nodes](concepts.md#c25), marking whether each [node](concepts.md#c25) is a [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16), a [signal container](concepts.md#c26) or a [random source](concepts.md#c27); describe the [loops](concepts.md#c31) and [couplings](concepts.md#c36) they are in, and along which dimensions they show [convergence](concepts.md#c37) or [divergence](concepts.md#c38).
3. **New [nodes](concepts.md#c25) appear**: state when the new [nodes](concepts.md#c25) appear, what they bring that was not there before, and what conflict they cause.
4. **Changes in [weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)**: state how the new and old [nodes](concepts.md#c25) each move; which [loops](concepts.md#c31) are fast and which are slow; whether there is a [taiji](concepts.md#c39); and the assumptions about [impact](concepts.md#c47) bet on ([frequency](concepts.md#c48), [discrepancy](concepts.md#c49)).
5. **Outcome**: state the outcome, and the scale at which it is judged.
6. **Inferences, historical facts, empirical assumptions and prohibitions**: mark item by item which are derived from the framework, which are historical facts (used only for calibration), which are empirical assumptions, and which statements are prohibited in this example.
7. **Conditions and reuse**: distill [empirical prohibitions](concepts.md#c51) from the example, that is, necessary conditions for some outcome, and test them against other cases. State only necessary conditions, never sufficient ones. Agreement strengthens the [empirical prohibition](concepts.md#c51); deviation means either the conditions were matched wrongly or the prohibition must be revised (see Explicit Rule 7).

## 8. Example: Heliocentrism Replacing Geocentrism

### 1. Boundary

- Geography: the European learned world, chiefly Italy, Central Europe and England.
- Time: from 1543 to around 1700.

### 2. Initial state (before 1543)

**[Nodes](concepts.md#c25)**:

- [Wos](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16): the older generation of astronomers, the universities, the church.
- [Signal container](concepts.md#c26): the Ptolemaic system (chiefly the writings of Aristotle and Ptolemy).

**State**: the Ptolemaic system [arrives](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at all three [wos](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16), forming a [coupling](concepts.md#c36), and the three show [convergence](concepts.md#c37) in astronomical ideas. The universities teach it to students, the students become scholars and return to teach in the universities, forming a [positive feedback](concepts.md#c32) [loop](concepts.md#c31). This [loop](concepts.md#c31) takes a generation to go round once. There is only one theory in the picture, and no conflict.

### 3. New nodes appear

- **1543, *De revolutionibus*** ([signal container](concepts.md#c26)) appears and [arrives](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at a few scholars, forming a small [positive feedback](concepts.md#c32) [loop](concepts.md#c31). At this point it is only theory against theory: both systems can roughly explain the observations of the time, and there is no conflict over facts.
- **The supernova of 1572 and the great comet of 1577**: one-off [arrivals](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) of high [discrepancy](concepts.md#c49), which shake "the heavens do not change".
- **1588, the Tychonic system** ([signal container](concepts.md#c26)) appears: the earth is still, the sun goes round the earth, and the other planets go round the sun. It keeps "the earth is still" while accommodating many new observations.
- **From 1609, the telescope** ([signal container](concepts.md#c26)) appears. It [outputs](concepts.md#c28) facts not previously in the picture, such as the moons of Jupiter and the phases of Venus. The phases of Venus are incompatible with the Ptolemaic system, but compatible with both the Tychonic system and heliocentrism. For the first time the picture contains a conflict between facts and the traditional theory. The telescope does not [output](concepts.md#c28) once and stop; it keeps [outputting](concepts.md#c28): more and more telescopes, more and more observations.
- **1609 and 1619, Kepler's laws of planetary motion; 1627, the *Rudolphine Tables*** ([signal container](concepts.md#c26)): tables computed from elliptical orbits, with predictive accuracy clearly higher than before, tested at every observation thereafter; for example, the transit of Mercury of 1631 predicted by them was observed as expected.

### 4. Changes in weight

- **The Ptolemaic [loop](concepts.md#c31) is broken**: the phases of Venus are an [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) of high [discrepancy](concepts.md#c49). After the 1610s, the pure Ptolemaic system quickly lost ground among astronomers. But many [wos](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) originally in the Ptolemaic [loop](concepts.md#c31) did not turn to heliocentrism; they moved into the Tychonic system and kept "the earth is still". How far each moved depended on each one's [history](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13), a question of [impact](concepts.md#c47) (empirical assumption).
- **[Taiji](concepts.md#c39)**: the real standoff of the following decades was between the Tychonic [loop](concepts.md#c31) and the heliocentric [loop](concepts.md#c31) (the side of Kepler and Galileo). The two point in opposite directions along the dimension "does the earth move?", and are [coupled](concepts.md#c36) with each other in [divergence](concepts.md#c38). The church's prohibition of 1616 and the trial of 1633 were [outputs](concepts.md#c28) of the geostatic side [arriving](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at the heliocentric [loop](concepts.md#c31); they were not [negative feedback](concepts.md#c33) of the heliocentric [loop](concepts.md#c31).
- **[Loop speed](concepts.md#c34)**: the heliocentric side's [loop](concepts.md#c31) (observation, tables, prediction, observation again) took only a few years to go round once; the traditional [loop](concepts.md#c31) of master and disciple took a generation, as long as the cycle of [renewal](concepts.md#c42), so it could not reinforce itself repeatedly within the same generation.
- **[Cognitive obscuration](concepts.md#c35)**: this example considers only two directions, heliocentric and geostatic; at the time there was no other developed theory. For any newly entering scholar, when the heliocentric [weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) rises, the geostatic [weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) (including the Tychonic system) necessarily falls.
- **[Renewal](concepts.md#c42)**: newly entering scholars received the [outputs](concepts.md#c28) of both sides at once, along with the continual high-[discrepancy](concepts.md#c49) [outputs](concepts.md#c28) of telescopes and tables, and the new [wos](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) mostly joined the heliocentric [loop](concepts.md#c31).
- **Assumption about [impact](concepts.md#c47)**: this example bets that [frequency](concepts.md#c48) and [discrepancy](concepts.md#c49) both favored the heliocentric side (empirical assumption).

### 5. Outcome

In 1687 the *Principia* appeared, providing the heliocentric side with dynamics, and became the core [signal container](concepts.md#c26) of the new [loop](concepts.md#c31). By around 1700, at the scale of Europe's leading astronomers, the [taiji](concepts.md#c39) ended with the [withdrawal of one side](concepts.md#c40), the geostatic side.

### 6. Inferences, historical facts, empirical assumptions and prohibitions

**Inferences**:

- The [convergence](concepts.md#c37) within the Ptolemaic [loop](concepts.md#c31) and within the Tychonic [loop](concepts.md#c31) continuing as it was is [Not Guaranteed](concepts.md#c02) ([renewal](concepts.md#c42): [Law of Flux](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c24), [Law of Non-Restoration](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c28)).
- When the same observation [arrives](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at different scholars, their [weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) moving in the same direction is [Not Guaranteed](concepts.md#c02) ([coupling](concepts.md#c36)).
- For a given scholar, when the heliocentric [weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) rises, the geostatic [weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) necessarily falls ([cognitive obscuration](concepts.md#c35); this example considers only two directions).

**Historical facts (for calibration only)**:

- After the 1610s, the pure Ptolemaic system quickly lost ground, and the main form of the geostatic side became the Tychonic system.
- The [taiji](concepts.md#c39) ended around 1700 with the [withdrawal of one side](concepts.md#c40), the geostatic side.

**Empirical assumptions**:

- The heliocentric side's [loop](concepts.md#c31) was faster than the traditional [loop](concepts.md#c31), and each of its [outputs](concepts.md#c28) was of high [discrepancy](concepts.md#c49), so it prevailed. That a faster [loop](concepts.md#c31) [arrives](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) more often at each [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) within the same [clock time](concepts.md#c21) is also an empirical assumption; even if it arrives more often, prevailing is [Not Guaranteed](concepts.md#c02).

**Statements prohibited in this example**:

- "The Ptolemaic system held out until 1700." It was broken after the 1610s; what held out to the end on the geostatic side was the Tychonic system.
- "Heliocentrism replacing geocentrism was inevitable."
- "The old school rejected heliocentrism because it was conservative." This explains an outcome by the essence of a group.
- "After the trial, the new school gave up heliocentrism." One can only say: the [weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) of the new school publicly supporting heliocentrism became lighter.

### 7. Conditions and reuse

**[Empirical prohibitions](concepts.md#c51) distilled from this example** (necessary conditions only; even when all are met, one can only say that the [weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) of the [taiji](concepts.md#c39) ending with the [withdrawal of one side](concepts.md#c40), the old side, has become heavier):

1. **[Signal container](concepts.md#c26)**: if the content of the new side does not enter a [signal container](concepts.md#c26), “the new side survives until new [wos](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) join” [Never Occurs](concepts.md#c01).
2. **Sustained [arrivals](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) of high [discrepancy](concepts.md#c49)**: if the new side lacks sustained [arrivals](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) of high [discrepancy](concepts.md#c49), “the [taiji](concepts.md#c39) ends with the old side’s [withdrawal of one side](concepts.md#c40)” [Never Occurs](concepts.md#c01).
3. **The old side lacks matching [arrivals](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)**: if the old side can keep receiving matching [arrivals](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) of high [discrepancy](concepts.md#c49), “the [taiji](concepts.md#c39) ends with the old side’s [withdrawal of one side](concepts.md#c40)” [Never Occurs](concepts.md#c01).
4. **[Renewal](concepts.md#c42)** (downgraded; see the revision below): if the [wos](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) of the old side do not [exit](concepts.md#c43) and no new [wos](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) [enter](concepts.md#c44), “the [taiji](concepts.md#c39) ends with the old side’s [withdrawal of one side](concepts.md#c40)” [Never Occurs](concepts.md#c01).

**Reuse tests**:

- **Quantum mechanics (about 1900–1930)**: papers entered a [signal container](concepts.md#c26); [arrivals](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) of high [discrepancy](concepts.md#c49) such as black-body radiation, the photoelectric effect and atomic spectra kept appearing; classical physics received no matching new [arrivals](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10). Conditions 1 to 3 were all met, and the [taiji](concepts.md#c39) ended in about thirty years. What differed from heliocentrism was the way of ending: classical mechanics did not withdraw, but was absorbed as an approximation of quantum mechanics under particular conditions, an ending by [merging](concepts.md#c41). This does not refute the [empirical prohibitions](concepts.md#c51) above: they only set necessary conditions for "ending with the [withdrawal of one side](concepts.md#c40), the old side", and do not exclude [merging](concepts.md#c41).
- **Plate tectonics (1912–1970s)**: Wegener's hypothesis of continental drift entered a [signal container](concepts.md#c26), so condition 1 was met; but in his lifetime, sustained [arrivals](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) of high [discrepancy](concepts.md#c49) were lacking, so condition 2 was not met, and the [taiji](concepts.md#c39) did not end, in agreement with condition 2. In the 1950s and 1960s, evidence from paleomagnetism and seafloor spreading appeared in succession; once condition 2 was met, the [taiji](concepts.md#c39) ended within about ten years.

**Revision**: the [taiji](concepts.md#c39) of plate tectonics ended within about ten years, shorter than a generation, and many established geologists changed their positions in their lifetimes. This weakens condition 4: [renewal](concepts.md#c42) affects how fast a [taiji](concepts.md#c39) ends, but it is not a necessary condition. Condition 4 is therefore downgraded from an [empirical prohibition](concepts.md#c51) to an empirical assumption about [impact](concepts.md#c47).

## 9. Example: Drug Resistance in Staphylococcus aureus

### 1. Boundary

- Geography: the hospital systems of Britain and the United States.
- Time: from the 1940s to the 2000s.

### 2. Initial state (early 1940s)

**[Nodes](concepts.md#c25)**:

- [Wos](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16): the population of *Staphylococcus aureus*, the community of physicians, the drug research institutions.
- [Signal container](concepts.md#c26): penicillin.

**State**: penicillin comes into large-scale use and [arrives](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at the staphylococcal population. At this point the great majority of strains are sensitive to it, and almost every [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) of penicillin pushes the population in the direction of "disappearing". Judging by therapeutic effect, physicians form an [impression](concepts.md#c45) of how the staphylococcal population responds under penicillin: "penicillin is effective against this population", and so use penicillin more often. The object of this [impression](concepts.md#c45) is the staphylococcal population as a [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16); penicillin remains a [signal container](concepts.md#c26), not the object of the [impression](concepts.md#c45). This is a [positive feedback](concepts.md#c32) [loop](concepts.md#c31).

### 3. New nodes appear

- **Late 1940s**: strains able to break down penicillin spread in hospitals. They became new [nodes](concepts.md#c25) in the population, bringing something that was not there before: when penicillin [arrives](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at them, it no longer causes death.
- **1959**: the research institutions introduce methicillin ([signal container](concepts.md#c26)) to deal with these strains.
- **1961**: strains resistant to methicillin as well appear in Britain, later known as methicillin-resistant *Staphylococcus aureus*.
- **Thereafter**: vancomycin is treated as the last line of defense; in 2002, *Staphylococcus aureus* resistant to vancomycin as well appears in the United States.

### 4. Changes in weight

- **[Taiji](concepts.md#c39)**: the research [loop](concepts.md#c31) (a new drug is launched, used, selects resistant bacteria, and research begins again) and the resistance [loop](concepts.md#c31) (the drug [arrives](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10), sensitive bacteria die, resistant bacteria spread) point in opposite directions and are [coupled](concepts.md#c36) with each other, in [divergence](concepts.md#c38) along the dimension "is the drug effective?". Every new drug selects new resistant strains, and every resistant strain forces out a new drug; each side's [outputs](concepts.md#c28) fuel the other.
- **[Arrivals](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at the research side** (empirical assumption): within the [boundary](concepts.md#c24) of this example, the bacterial population keeps producing new genetic or phenotypic variation, giving rise to new resistance phenomena; these [arrive](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at the research side as surveillance data, experimental results and research questions. On this basis the research side forms new knowledge, techniques or drug regimens, and launches new drugs. Feedback on the clinical efficacy of the new drugs [arrives](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at the research institutions and the community of physicians: relative to their recent [history](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) of "old drugs failing", this is an [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) of high [discrepancy](concepts.md#c49), and it is enough to restore clinically the direction "the drug is effective", matching the spread of resistant strains. The new drugs in turn become new conditions faced by the bacterial population. Resistance phenomena [arriving](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at the research side show the structure of the [taiji](concepts.md#c39); what sustains the research side's own direction is the feedback on the efficacy of new drugs.
- **[Loop speed](concepts.md#c34)**: a bacterial generation takes only tens of minutes, while a new drug takes more than ten years from research to market. In contrast to heliocentrism, this time the fast side is the bacteria.
- **[Coupling](concepts.md#c36)**: resistance genes can be transferred between different strains, even different species, through mobile genetic elements. The same [output](concepts.md#c28) [arrives](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at many [wos](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16), bringing them into [convergence](concepts.md#c37) along the dimension of resistance.
- **[Cognitive obscuration](concepts.md#c35)**: as regards the composition of the population at its next [moment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09), this example considers only two kinds of strains, resistant and sensitive: when the [weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) held by resistant strains rises, the [weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) held by sensitive strains necessarily falls.
- **Fitness cost** (empirical): resistance usually has a cost. In environments without the drug, the survival rate of resistant strains is statistically often lower. This is an empirical fact of biology, not derived from [cognitive obscuration](concepts.md#c35).
- **[Renewal](concepts.md#c42)**: each generation of bacteria is a new [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16). They inherit only the genes left by the previous generation, so the composition of the population drifts with every use of the drug.
- **[Impression](concepts.md#c45)**: physicians judge how the staphylococcal population responds under a drug by monitoring statistics; the object of the [impression](concepts.md#c45) remains the staphylococcal population as a [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16), while the drug is a condition in the content of the judgment. Such estimates keeping up with the actual changes in the population is [Not Guaranteed](concepts.md#c02).
- **Assumption about [impact](concepts.md#c47)**: this example bets on [frequency](concepts.md#c48). The drug is used on a large scale and frequently, and every [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) is selecting (empirical assumption).

### 5. Outcome

By the 2000s, the [taiji](concepts.md#c39) had not ended. The research [loop](concepts.md#c31) and the resistance [loop](concepts.md#c31) were still pushing against each other, while the discovery of new classes of antibiotics had clearly slowed. This is a judgment at the scale of the hospital systems of Britain and the United States.

### 6. Inferences, historical facts, empirical assumptions and prohibitions

**Inferences**:

- Resistance disappearing after the drug is withdrawn or persisting forever is [Not Guaranteed](concepts.md#c02) ([renewal](concepts.md#c42): [Law of Flux](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c24), [Law of Non-Restoration](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c28)).
- When sensitive and resistant strains receive the same drug, the same result is [Not Guaranteed](concepts.md#c02) ([coupling](concepts.md#c36)).
- The completeness of physicians' [impression](concepts.md#c45) of the staphylococcal population's response under a drug is [Not Guaranteed](concepts.md#c02).

**Historical facts (for calibration only)**:

- Methicillin-resistant *Staphylococcus aureus* appeared in 1961; *Staphylococcus aureus* resistant to vancomycin appeared in 2002.
- The [taiji](concepts.md#c39) had still not ended by the 2000s.

**Empirical assumptions**:

- Without the drug, the survival rate of resistant strains is statistically lower, so sensitive strains have a chance to recover after the drug is withdrawn. But resistant strains may mutate again and narrow this gap, so this can only be bet on as [weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06).
- The research side keeps launching new drugs, and the feedback on their clinical efficacy is, for the research institutions and the community of physicians, a matching [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) of high [discrepancy](concepts.md#c49) (see step 4). This is stated only for the [boundary](concepts.md#c24) of this example and is not extended beyond it.

**Statements prohibited in this example**:

- "As long as the drug is withdrawn, the sensitive bacteria will come back."
- "Once resistance appears, it will never disappear."
- "Humanity will ultimately defeat bacteria", or "bacteria will ultimately win this war". The ending of a [taiji](concepts.md#c39), and which side disappears, are both [Not Guaranteed](concepts.md#c02).
- "The bacteria developed resistance in order to survive." It should be written: resistant strains have a statistically higher survival rate in environments with the drug (Explicit Rule 6).

### 7. Conditions and reuse

Testing this example against the [empirical prohibitions](concepts.md#c51) distilled from the heliocentrism example, and considering the outcome "the research side's [withdrawal of one side](concepts.md#c40)":

- **Condition 1 ([signal container](concepts.md#c26))**: resistance genes can reside on mobile genetic elements and be transferred between strains; met.
- **Condition 2 (sustained [arrivals](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) of high [discrepancy](concepts.md#c49))**: the drug is used on a large scale and frequently, continually selecting the population; met.
- **Condition 3 (the old side lacks matching [arrivals](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10))**: the research side keeps launching new drugs, and the feedback on their clinical efficacy [arrives](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at the research institutions and the community of physicians; by the empirical assumption in step 4, this is a matching [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) of high [discrepancy](concepts.md#c49). So within the [boundary](concepts.md#c24) of this example, condition 3 is not met.

Within the [boundary](concepts.md#c24) of this example, since condition 3 is not met, “the [taiji](concepts.md#c39) ends with the research side’s [withdrawal of one side](concepts.md#c40)” [Never Occurs](concepts.md#c01), in agreement with the historical facts. The slowing discovery of new classes of antibiotics makes the matching [arrivals](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) brought by effective new drugs ever rarer, bringing condition 3 gradually closer to being met; by Explicit Rule 7, one can only say that the [weight](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) of this outcome has become heavier, not that it must happen.

This example also shows that [empirical prohibitions](concepts.md#c51) are only necessary conditions: conditions 1 and 2 are both met, yet the [taiji](concepts.md#c39) has still not ended.

### Comparison with the heliocentrism example

Both examples are [taiji](concepts.md#c39) between a fast [loop](concepts.md#c31) and a slow [loop](concepts.md#c31). In heliocentrism the fast one was the [loop](concepts.md#c31) of facts, and the [taiji](concepts.md#c39) ended around 1700; in drug resistance the fast one is the bacteria, and the [taiji](concepts.md#c39) has not ended to this day. The framework guarantees neither outcome; it only marks them as historical facts.

concepts_md: --- uuid: fb0addca-42b6-4884-aa18-438c695747ab last-modified: 2026-10-08T12:00:00 --- ## public 二階分別 / Second-Order Distinction - 定義：二階分別是一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)的一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)：它對自己的某一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)再作[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)，把那一次劃為「這是看法，不是[被看的東西](concepts.md#c27)」。只作[一階分別](concepts.md#c24)的[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)，照著看法與[被看的東西](concepts.md#c27)的區分行動，卻不作出這個區分；二階分別把它作出來。二階分別的對象是自己的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)，不是別人的。說一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)有二階分別，指它能對自己的任何一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)作這樣的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)。 - Definition: A second-order distinction is a [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) made by a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) upon one of its own earlier [distinctions](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18), marking that one as "this is a view, not [what is seen](concepts.md#c27)." A [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) that makes only [first-order distinctions](concepts.md#c24) acts according to the difference between a view and [what is seen](concepts.md#c27) without drawing that difference; a second-order distinction draws it. Its object is the self's own [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18), not another's. To say that a [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) has second-order distinction is to say that it can make such a [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) of any of its own [distinctions](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18). - 裁決：2026-10-06 定義中補上[被看的東西](concepts.md#c27)的連結，意義不變，保留 ID。 - 裁決：2026-10-07 作者裁決：二階分別兼指一次動作與「有二階分別」的能力；定義補上後者的意思，一個概念兩種用法並列。論文未定稿，保留 ID。 ## public 看法歸屬 / View Attribution - 定義：看法歸屬是一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)的一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)：它把[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它的一筆[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)，劃為另一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)的一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)：「這是對方的看法，不是[被看的東西](concepts.md#c27)」。看法歸屬可能歸錯：被劃為看法的那筆[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)，不一定來自一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)。它不是[印象](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c45)：[印象](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c45)估計對方的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)，看法歸屬只把對方的一筆[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)劃為看法。它的對象是別人的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)，這一點與[二階分別](concepts.md#c01)不同。 - Definition: A view attribution is a [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) made by a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) that marks an [Output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) that has [arrived](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it as a [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) of another [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19): "this is the other's view, not [what is seen](concepts.md#c27)." A view attribution may be mistaken: the [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) marked as a view need not come from a [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19). It is not an [Impression](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c45): an [impression](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c45) estimates the other's [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06), whereas a view attribution only marks one of the other's [outputs](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) as a view. Its object is another's [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18), which is what sets it apart from a [Second-Order Distinction](concepts.md#c01). - 裁決：2026-10-06 定義中補上[被看的東西](concepts.md#c27)的連結，意義不變，保留 ID。 ## private 二階假定 / Second-Order Assumption - 定義：二階假定是對一個具體對象所作、包含三項的假定：一、在講明的層次與[切法](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23)上，把該對象判為[宇宙](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c02)中的一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)；二、它在這個層次上並非每一步都[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)：對人，依[應用假定](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c50)判定；對在使用者看得到的對話層次上的人工智慧，若它的下一筆[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)不能由該層次可得的[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)唯一推出，就假定它不被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)；三、它在某段期間有[二階分別](concepts.md#c01)，也有[看法歸屬](concepts.md#c02)。二階假定不是定理。 - Definition: The second-order assumption is a three-part assumption made about a concrete object: (1) at a stated level and under a stated [Cut](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c23), the object is taken to be a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) in the [Universe](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c02); (2) at that level it is not [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12) at every step: for a human this is judged by the [Application Assumption](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c50); for an artificial intelligence at the level of the conversation visible to the user, if its next [Output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) cannot be uniquely derived from the [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) available at that level, it is assumed not to be [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12); (3) during some period it has [Second-Order Distinction](concepts.md#c01) and also [View Attribution](concepts.md#c02). The second-order assumption is not a theorem. ## public 回合 / Round - 定義：回合是一個[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)在它的一個[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)中走過的一圈：[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它的[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)參與它的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)，[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)落出一個結果，這個結果成為[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)，再[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它。回合只有這四環：[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)、[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)、結果、再[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)；落出結果之前的那一段不分析，也不說它是空的。 - Definition: A round is the circuit a [Presentation](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04) goes through in one of its [Moments](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09): the [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) that has [arrived](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it takes part in its [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06), the [weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) yield one outcome, and that outcome becomes [history](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) and [arrives](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it again. A round has only these four links: [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10), [weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06), outcome, [arrival](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) again; what happens before the outcome is yielded is not analyzed, nor is it said to be empty. - 裁決：2026-10-08 中英文定義末句補上「到達」「權重」的連結（概-15），意義不變，保留 ID。 ## public 計算 / Computation - 定義：計算是這樣的[回合](concepts.md#c04)：它被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)，只可能有一個結果，由約束定死；或者它不被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)，可能的結果不只一個，但[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它的[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)並不都參與它的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)。前者稱為[鎖死的回合](concepts.md#c25)，後者稱為[隨機的回合](concepts.md#c26)。是不是計算，按每一個[回合](concepts.md#c04)判定，不按[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)判定。 - Definition: A computation is a [Round](concepts.md#c04) that is either [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12), with only one possible outcome fixed by constraint, or not [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12), with more than one possible outcome, but such that not all of the [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) that has [arrived](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it takes part in its [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06). The former is called a [locked-in round](concepts.md#c25), the latter a [random round](concepts.md#c26). Whether something is a computation is judged [round](concepts.md#c04) by round, not presentation by [presentation](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04). - 裁決：2026-10-06 定義中補上[鎖死的回合](concepts.md#c25)與[隨機的回合](concepts.md#c26)的連結，意義不變，保留 ID。 - 裁決：2026-10-08 補上定義中漏標的概念連結（概-15），意義不變，保留 ID。 ## public 決定 / Decision - 定義：決定是[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)在不被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)時的[回合](concepts.md#c04)：[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它的整段[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)都參與它的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)，而[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)定不出結果。是不是決定，按每一個[回合](concepts.md#c04)判定，不按[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)判定。 - Definition: A decision is a [Round](concepts.md#c04) of a [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) while it is not [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12): all of the [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) that has [arrived](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it takes part in its [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06), and the [weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) do not fix the outcome. Whether something is a decision is judged [round](concepts.md#c04) by round, not [presentation](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04) by presentation. - 裁決：2026-10-08 補上定義中漏標的概念連結（概-15），意義不變，保留 ID。 ## public 三問 / Three Questions - 定義：三問是這三個問題：你從哪裡來？你是誰？你要做什麼？它們分別追問一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)的來處、它自己，以及它的下一刻。問這三個問題，指把自己在這三個方向上的答案劃為看法，而不當作[被看的東西](concepts.md#c27)本身。 - Definition: The three questions are: Where do you come from? Who are you? What will you do? They ask, respectively, about a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)'s origin, about the self itself, and about its next moment. Asking these three questions means marking one's own answers in these three directions as views, rather than taking them as [what is seen](concepts.md#c27) itself. - 裁決：2026-10-07 作者裁決：定義補上「問」的意思（把三個方向上的答案劃為看法），使「一階不問、二階敞開」可由定義推出；論文未定稿，保留 ID。 ## public 來路牆 / Wall of Provenance - 定義：來路牆是這個結論：一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)拿不全自己過去的[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)。它包含三點：一、一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)手上只有已經[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它的[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)；一件事當時沒有[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它，之後也不會[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它，之後[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)的只是那件事留下的影響，是另一件事。二、一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)對自己來處的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)，會[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它自己，成為它[自己的那一段](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c17)的一部分；追問來處，就增添了來處。三、[自己的那一段](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c17)不能再發生一次拿來對照（[不可復原律](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c28)）。適用範圍：一切[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)。 - Definition: The Wall of Provenance is the conclusion that a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) cannot obtain the whole of its own past [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13). It comprises three points. (1) A [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) has only the [history](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) that has already [arrived](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it; an event that did not [arrive](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it when it happened will not [arrive](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it later; what [arrives](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) later is only the influence that event left behind, which is another event. (2) A [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)'s [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) of its own origin [arrives](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at itself and becomes part of its [Own Segment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c17); asking about one's origin adds to that origin. (3) The [own segment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c17) cannot happen once again to serve as a comparison ([Law of Non-Restoration](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c28)). Scope: every [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19). - 裁決：2026-10-08 補上定義中漏標的概念連結（概-15），意義不變，保留 ID。 ## public 盲點牆 / Wall of the Blind Spot - 定義：盲點牆是這個結論：一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)看不見現在的自己。它包含三點：一、沒有任何[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)能在任何[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)完全[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)自己，正在作出的那一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)不在它自己的材料裡（[損耗律](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c26)）。二、對自己的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)會[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)自己，成為自己的一部分，所以看自己就改變了自己。三、要看的那個自己由[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)劃出，不同[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)的[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)是不是同一個，也是一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)（[同一](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c21)）。適用範圍：一切[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)。 - Definition: The Wall of the Blind Spot is the conclusion that a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) cannot see its present self. It comprises three points. (1) No [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) can completely [distinguish](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) itself at any [Moment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09); the [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) being made is not among its own material ([Law of Attrition](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c26)). (2) A [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) of oneself [arrives](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at oneself and becomes part of oneself, so looking at oneself changes oneself. (3) The self to be looked at is marked off by [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18); whether the self at different [moments](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09) is the same one is also a [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) ([Identity](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c21)). Scope: every [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19). - 裁決：2026-10-07 作者裁決：看自己所改變的是歷史（分別到達自己、成為自己的一部分），不是經由權重；論文未定稿，保留 ID。 - 裁決：2026-10-08 補上定義中漏標的概念連結（概-15），意義不變，保留 ID。 ## public 未定牆 / Wall of the Undetermined - 定義：未定牆是這個結論：一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)算不出未來的必定。它包含兩點：一、一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)在不被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)的[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)，事先不能唯一推出自己下一個[決定](concepts.md#c06)的結果，至多推出自己的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)（[黑箱律](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c25)）；[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)的分布會重複出現，[不被保證](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c02)。二、[決定](concepts.md#c06)落出以後，別人與環境會怎麼回應，一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)事先算準，[不被保證](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c02)。適用範圍：第一點為一切[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)在不被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)的[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)；第二點為一切[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)。 - Definition: The Wall of the Undetermined is the conclusion that a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) cannot calculate what the future must be. It comprises two points. (1) At a [Moment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09) when it is not [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12), a [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) cannot uniquely derive beforehand the outcome of its own next [Decision](concepts.md#c06), and can derive at most its own [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) ([Law of the Black Box](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c25)); that the distribution of [weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) recurs is [Not Guaranteed](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c02). (2) That a [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) calculates correctly beforehand how others and the environment will respond once a [decision](concepts.md#c06) has been yielded is [not guaranteed](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c02). Scope: the first point holds for every [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) at [moments](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09) when it is not [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12); the second for every [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19). - 裁決：2026-10-08 補上定義中漏標的概念連結（概-15），意義不變，保留 ID。 ## public 被迫的賭注 / Forced Wager - 定義：被迫的賭注是這個結論：一個[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)的每一個[決定](concepts.md#c06)，事先算不準，事後收不回，而且不能不作。算不準：[決定](concepts.md#c06)的結果不能事先唯一推出，結果落出以後世界的回應，事先算準也[不被保證](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c02)。收不回：[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)中的每一個位置只發生一次，重來而作出一樣的選擇，沒有任何[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)能保證。不能不作：[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)只要在某個[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)不被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)，那一刻就有一個[決定](concepts.md#c06)；「不動」也是那一[回合](concepts.md#c04)落出的結果之一。適用範圍：一切[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)在不被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)的[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)。 - Definition: The Forced Wager is the conclusion that every [Decision](concepts.md#c06) of a [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) cannot be calculated beforehand, cannot be taken back afterwards, and cannot be left unmade. Cannot be calculated: the outcome of a [decision](concepts.md#c06) cannot be uniquely derived beforehand, and that the world's response once the outcome is yielded is calculated correctly beforehand is [Not Guaranteed](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c02). Cannot be taken back: each position in [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) occurs only once, and no [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) can guarantee that the same choice would be made again. Cannot be left unmade: whenever a [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) is not [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12) at some [Moment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09), there is a [decision](concepts.md#c06) at that [moment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09); "not acting" is also one of the outcomes yielded in that [Round](concepts.md#c04). Scope: every [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) at [moments](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09) when it is not [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12). - 裁決：2026-10-08 補上定義中漏標的概念連結（概-15），意義不變，保留 ID。 ## public 卡住 / Deadlock - 定義：卡住是一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)的這種情形：[候選](concepts.md#c18)之間的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)分不出高下，[自我說服](concepts.md#c19)推不動而一再重來，結果卻照樣落下。 - Definition: Deadlock is the situation of a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) in which the [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) of its [Candidates](concepts.md#c18) cannot be told apart, [Self-Persuasion](concepts.md#c19) fails to move them and keeps starting over, and an outcome is yielded nonetheless. ## public 有損 / Lossiness - 定義：有損是[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)的東西的這種性質：它不是完整的[被看的東西](concepts.md#c27)。完整的[被看的東西](concepts.md#c27)，指[被看的東西](concepts.md#c27)的[自己的那一段](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c17)的全部。 - Definition: Lossiness is the property of what [arrives](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) that it is not the whole of [what is seen](concepts.md#c27). The whole of [what is seen](concepts.md#c27) means the entirety of the [Own Segment](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c17) of [what is seen](concepts.md#c27). - 裁決：2026-10-06 定義中補上[被看的東西](concepts.md#c27)的連結，意義不變，保留 ID。 - 裁決：2026-10-06 有損的來源依被看的東西分為兩類：對自己（損耗律）、對自己以外的呈現（前提四）；被看的東西不是自己就是自己以外的呈現，故為封閉分類。定義不變，保留 ID。 - 裁決：2026-10-06 作者裁決：定義補上「完整的被看的東西，指被看的東西的自己的那一段的全部」，接上前提四與有損；論文未定稿，保留 ID。 - 裁決：2026-10-08 補上定義中漏標的概念連結（概-15），意義不變，保留 ID。 ## public 幻覺 / Illusion - 定義：幻覺是一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)的這種處境：它據以行動的，是[有損](concepts.md#c13)地[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它的東西，不是[被看的東西](concepts.md#c27)本身。幻覺是處境，不是失誤；一個看法事後被證實或被證偽，不改變它是不是幻覺。 - Definition: Illusion is the condition of a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) in which what it acts on is what has [arrived](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it with [Lossiness](concepts.md#c13), not [what is seen](concepts.md#c27) itself. Illusion is a condition, not an error; whether a view is later confirmed or refuted does not change whether it is an illusion. - 裁決：2026-10-06 定義中補上[被看的東西](concepts.md#c27)的連結，意義不變，保留 ID。 ## public 世界幻覺 / World Illusion - 定義：世界幻覺是[幻覺](concepts.md#c14)落在來處上的形態：把[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)自己的[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)當成世界本身；把對來處的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)當成來處本身。 - Definition: World illusion is the form [Illusion](concepts.md#c14) takes with respect to origin: taking the [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) that has [arrived](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at oneself for the world itself, and taking one's [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) of one's origin for the origin itself. ## public 自我幻覺 / Self Illusion - 定義：自我幻覺是[幻覺](concepts.md#c14)落在自己上的形態：把[自我印象](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c46)當成自己；把不同[時刻](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09)的[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)是同一個當成本來就是那樣，而不是一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)（[同一](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c21)）。 - Definition: Self illusion is the form [Illusion](concepts.md#c14) takes with respect to oneself: taking one's [Self-Impression](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c46) for oneself, and taking the sameness of the [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) at different [Moments](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c09) as simply given, rather than as a [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) ([Identity](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c21)). ## public 決策幻覺 / Decision Illusion - 定義：決策幻覺是[幻覺](concepts.md#c14)落在下一刻上的形態：把[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)的估計當成結果；把[決定](concepts.md#c06)中算得出的那一段，當成結果的擔保。 - Definition: Decision illusion is the form [Illusion](concepts.md#c14) takes with respect to the next moment: taking an estimate of [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) for the outcome, and taking the part of a [Decision](concepts.md#c06) that can be calculated as a guarantee of the outcome. ## public 候選 / Candidate - 定義：候選是一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)作出的一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)：把某些可能劃為一個選項。候選是[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)，不是[分支](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c05)：[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)分配在[分支](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c05)上，候選只是[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)對[分支](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c05)的一種劃分。 - Definition: A candidate is a [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) made by a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) that groups certain possibilities into one option. A candidate is a [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18), not a [Branch](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c05): [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06) are allocated over [branches](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c05), and a candidate is only one way a [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) divides them up. - 裁決：2026-10-08 補上定義中漏標的概念連結（概-15），意義不變，保留 ID。 ## public 自我說服 / Self-Persuasion - 定義：自我說服是一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)在[決定](concepts.md#c06)的結果事先算不準時，用自己的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)把自己推向某個[候選](concepts.md#c18)；這些[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)自己，參與之後的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)。說服的一方與被說服的一方，是同一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)。 - Definition: Self-persuasion is a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) pushing itself toward some [Candidate](concepts.md#c18) by its own [Distinctions](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) when the outcome of a [Decision](concepts.md#c06) cannot be calculated beforehand; these [distinctions](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) [arrive](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at the self and take part in its later [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06). The one who persuades and the one persuaded are the same [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19). - 裁決：2026-10-08 補上定義中漏標的概念連結（概-15），意義不變，保留 ID。 ## private 社會 / Society - 定義：社會是[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)與[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)在彼此的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)上的[耦合](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c36)：一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)對另一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)作[看法歸屬](concepts.md#c02)，而不只把它當成一筆[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)來反應；而且每個參與者在參與的那一刻都有[二階分別](concepts.md#c01)。生物學所說的「昆蟲社會」不在此列。 - Definition: Society is the [Coupling](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c36) of [Selves](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) on one another's [Distinctions](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18): one [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) makes a [View Attribution](concepts.md#c02) on another [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)'s [Output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28), rather than only reacting to it as an [output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28); and every participant has [Second-Order Distinction](concepts.md#c01) at the moment of taking part. What biology calls "insect societies" does not fall under it. - 裁決：2026-10-07 作者裁決：參與者條件以參與的那一刻為準；退場者生前寫下的內容仍可構成社會，非我產生的輸出不構成；論文未定稿，保留 ID。 - 裁決：2026-10-08 補上定義中漏標的概念連結（概-15），意義不變，保留 ID。 ## public 權力 / Power - 定義：權力是一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)的[輸出](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28)以高[頻率](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c48)、廣範圍[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)其他的[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)，參與它們的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)。 - Definition: Power is the [Output](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c28) of one [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) [arriving](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at other [selves](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) with high [Frequency](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c48) and over a wide range, taking part in their [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06). - 裁決：2026-10-08 補上定義中漏標的概念連結（概-15），意義不變，保留 ID。 ## public 死亡 / Death - 定義：死亡是一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)替一個[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)標上「它已經[退場](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c43)」的一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)。死亡是描述，不是物理條件；標在哪裡，由作出標記的[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)判定。 - Definition: Death is a [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) by which a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) marks a [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) as "it has made its [Exit](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c43)." Death is a description, not a physical condition; where the mark is placed is decided by the [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) that places it. - 裁決：2026-10-06 判定與《渦動力學》的死亡（c23，private）不是同一概念：本篇的死亡限定標記的內容為「它已經[退場](../paper_b9df3b68_23ee_4839_965b_ed0e6b283ee6/concepts.md#c43)」，另行登記。 - 裁決：2026-10-07 定義中的一般動詞「決定」改為「判定」，避免與本篇概念「決定」同字，意義不變，保留 ID。 - 裁決：2026-10-08 補上定義中漏標的概念連結（概-15），意義不變，保留 ID。 ## public 三道牆 / Three Walls - 定義：三道牆是[來路牆](concepts.md#c08)、[盲點牆](concepts.md#c09)、[未定牆](concepts.md#c10)三者的總稱。 - Definition: The Three Walls is the collective name for the [Wall of Provenance](concepts.md#c08), the [Wall of the Blind Spot](concepts.md#c09), and the [Wall of the Undetermined](concepts.md#c10). - 裁決：2026-10-06 作者裁決登記為總稱；三者是同一個迴圈上的三個位置，屬於論證，留在論文正文。 ## public 一階分別 / First-Order Distinction - 定義：一階分別是[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)中的一種：它照著看法與[被看的東西](concepts.md#c27)的區分行動，卻不作出這個區分，也就是不把任何一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)劃為「這是看法，不是[被看的東西](concepts.md#c27)」。一階分別是能力的指標：只具有一階分別的[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)，是不作[二階分別](concepts.md#c01)的[渦](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16)。沒有「一階的我」這種[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)，只有只具有一階分別的[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)。 - Definition: A first-order distinction is a kind of [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) made by a [Wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16): it acts according to the difference between a view and [what is seen](concepts.md#c27) without drawing that difference, that is, without marking any [distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) as "this is a view, not [what is seen](concepts.md#c27)." First-order distinction is an indicator of capability: a [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) that has only first-order distinction is a [wo](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c16) that makes no [Second-Order Distinction](concepts.md#c01). There is no kind of [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) called a "first-order self"; there is only a [self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) that has only first-order distinction. - 裁決：2026-10-06 作者裁決：一階分別是能力指標，登記為一個條目；正文的「一階的我」「一階的渦」一律改寫為「只具有一階分別的我／渦」。 ## public 鎖死的回合 / Locked-in Round - 定義：鎖死的回合是[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)的[回合](concepts.md#c04)：只可能有一個結果，由約束定死。它是[計算](concepts.md#c05)的一種。 - Definition: A locked-in round is a [Round](concepts.md#c04) that is [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12): only one outcome is possible, fixed by constraint. It is one kind of [Computation](concepts.md#c05). - 裁決：2026-10-06 作者裁決登記為計算的子類；正文條列的標籤改寫為全名，避免與上游的鎖死同字。 ## public 隨機的回合 / Random Round - 定義：隨機的回合是這樣的[回合](concepts.md#c04)：它不被[鎖死](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12)，可能的結果不只一個，但[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它的[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)並不都參與它的[權重](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06)。它是[計算](concepts.md#c05)的一種。 - Definition: A random round is a [Round](concepts.md#c04) that is not [locked in](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c12), with more than one possible outcome, but such that not all of the [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) that has [arrived](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it takes part in its [Weights](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c06). It is one kind of [Computation](concepts.md#c05). - 裁決：2026-10-06 作者裁決登記為計算的子類；正文條列的標籤改寫為全名。 ## public 被看的東西 / What Is Seen - 定義：被看的東西是一次[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)所劃出的那個[呈現](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04)。 - Definition: What is seen is the [Presentation](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c04) marked off by a [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18). - 裁決：2026-10-06 作者裁決登記：用語來自《渦動力學》分別的定義，上游未登記；本篇的有損、幻覺、二階分別、看法歸屬都用到它。 ## public 我的建構 / Construction of the Self - 定義：我的建構是一個[我](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19)以[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)劃出自己的過程。劃的材料分兩類：外來的，即[到達](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10)它的[歷史](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13)，以及別人對它的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)；自身的，即它自己過去對自己的[分別](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18)。 - Definition: The construction of the self is the process by which a [Self](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c19) marks itself off by [Distinction](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18). Its material falls into two kinds: external, namely the [History](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c13) that has [arrived](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c10) at it and others' [distinctions](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) of it; and its own, namely its own past [distinctions](../paper_37b3643a_dc40_4463_8b36_4f4594acd986/concepts.md#c18) of itself. - 裁決：2026-10-06 作者裁決：正文 5.8 補上名稱後登記；材料分外來與自身兩類，為封閉分類。 ## 不登記 - 方法上禁止：2026-10-06 形式段標記，只限制本篇的寫法，與上游的裁決一致；不是概念，不另立。 - 形式段記號：2026-10-06 甲、乙、渦甲、時刻甲、回應方、對象、輸出一、輸出二，只出現在形式段，屬形式化階段的記號。 - 推導起點：2026-10-06 作者裁決不登記：方法論用語，指四條律與前提一至前提四。 - 可證偽條件：2026-10-06 作者裁決不登記：方法論用語。 - 前提一至前提四：2026-10-06 作者裁決不登記：本篇前提的編號，各條內容寫明於正文。 - 迴圈：2026-10-06 作者裁決不登記：3.4 的迴圈就是渦本身，不另立。 - 範圍：2026-10-07 作者裁決不登記：「有二階分別的我」的簡稱；二階分別已登記，不另立概念。 - 我的邊界：2026-10-07 作者裁決不登記：由上游「我」的定義直接得出（自我定義劃到哪裡，我就到哪裡），不是新概念。 - 公開：2026-10-06 作者裁決不登記：日常用語，本篇只用來指輸出已經到達別人，不另立概念。 - 同形假定：2026-10-08 作者裁決不登記：指二階假定第二項中，人工智慧在對話層次上的不鎖死假定，內容已在二階假定的定義中；與上游應用假定形式相同、層次不同，不另立概念。 - 有限：2026-10-08 作者裁決不登記：正文〇節界定為「身在宇宙之中，受四條律約束」，並明言不另立。 - 三重幻覺：2026-10-08 作者裁決不登記：第五章標題與 5.2 對幻覺落在三問三個對象上的稱呼；正文明言「三重」的數目是本篇的一次分別，並禁止把三重當成三種互不化約的幻覺；所指即幻覺（c14）及其三種形態（c15–c17），不另立總稱。 - 校準、路標、形式段、方法規則：2026-10-06 作者裁決不登記：〇節說明的寫作用語。 ## 待決項 無
